notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope you are doing well !

Some new bug fixes have been pushed, you will find them in the thread below this message.

We just wanted to let you know that this year's beginning has been pretty busy, thus we could not implement and fix as many bugs as we wanted.
We have tried for a long moment to improve the visuals to the Quest version (to make it visually closer to the Steam version), while keeping the performance high, unfortunately our attempts did not have good results yet, but we will keep on going with other solutions !

We have still many ideas to make the experience more enjoyable and unique, for the moment our next priority will be to translate the game in more languages so it can be more accessible to more players 😄 

Thanks a lot for sticking around and for playing our game,

Take care ☺️



Changelog:
- Better colliders to avoid the player to go through objects have been added
- Add an option to skip the intro cinematic: now you can
- Fixed the bug where the player couldn't go back to menu in Exploration Mode
- Fixed the bug where player can move freely after returning to main menu (this should only be possible in the Exploration Mode)

notes.title: Hotfix on fans and shadows
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just pushed a quick fix on a bug where the fans' color don't match the incoming ones in the Only Fans Mode. We also adjusted the shadows in the higher quality settings.

Thanks for your patience and for playing our game, and take care 😊

notes.title: New Gameplay experiment in the Play Test available
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We hope you are having a nice week :)

The game has received a new update with a new gameplay we would like you to test !
In the new version, the shurikens are replaced by small planets that you have to slice with your katana.

We would love to have you try this version and let us know what you think about it, compared to the old gameplay, and your ideas or if you have other suggestions in general !

Don't hesitate to join our discord to discuss with us: https://discord.gg/vUrd9ytb3K

Changelog:
- Fixed the bug where the leaderboard was not showing if we haven't played the song yet + add loading animation and a lil message if the song was never played
- More music to play :)
- Fixed and cleaned the score display in the songs' menu (score was overflowing + showed decimals while it shouldn't)
- Fixed a bug where musical elements were not disappearing at the end of the game
